<thought>Based on the high‑resolution ESI‑MS data, the most intense ion is at m/z 183.0451, which corresponds to a protonated molecule [M+H]+. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral mass of ~182.0378 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈10 % M+1) suggests about nine carbon atoms. A formula that matches this mass and isotopic pattern is C₉H₁₀O₂S (neutral monoisotopic mass 182.04015 Da, [M+H]+ = 183.04743 Da, within typical high‑resolution tolerance). Therefore the molecular formula is C9H10O2S.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H10O2S</final_answer>
